rules.text: Sensory Domination: a failing creature with a special sense is Blinded for the duration (or until the start of your next turn).

castOption.label: Onijutsu: Sensory Domination (1 Oni-Coil)
castOption.note: a failing creature with a special sense is Blinded for the duration (or until the start of your next turn).

system.description: A creature that fails their saving throw against the amplified Genjutsu, that have a special sense such as Blind Sight or Chakra Sight are instead Blinded for the duration of the jutsu. If the jutsu doesn’t have a duration, they remain blinded until the beginning of your next turn.
